Package Application.GameScreens

Class Home

java.lang.Object
Application.GameScreens.Home
public class Home extends Object
The Home class represents the main game screen where the user interacts with their pet duck.

It sets up the user interface including action buttons (feed, play, gift, sleep), displays pet status messages, handles animations for pet behavior, and provides navigation to other screens such as the Vet, Park, and Store. This class also continuously checks the pet's status (e.g., anger, health, and death) and updates the UI accordingly.
Author:
Daniel Harapiak, Brandon Nguyen, Dinith Nawaratne, Zachary Goodman

  • Constructor Details

    • Home

      public Home(Main main, Duck petIgnored, Inventory invIgnored, GameSettingsAndStats settingsIgnored)
      Constructs the Home screen and initializes the UI components, animations, and event handlers. The constructor always fetches the updated global state from the Main object, sets up UI elements, and starts background processes such as stats tracking and coin generation.
      Parameters:
      main - The main application instance containing the global state and scene management.
      petIgnored - Ignored parameter; the current pet is fetched from the main instance.
      invIgnored - Ignored parameter; the current inventory is fetched from the main instance.
      settingsIgnored - Ignored parameter; the current game settings are fetched from the main instance.
